notes: v2: the art pack is delivered as ATLASES, not individual sprites (see assets/raw/ASSET_GUIDE.md, the authoritative delivery doc).

Phase A flow: generate via ChatGPT using assets/CHATGPT_BRIEF.md -> drop PNGs into assets/raw/ -> `npm run art` slices atlases per the frames below, trims transparent padding, resizes, outputs to public/assets/.
map_labels_overlay was REJECTED/replaced — route labels and text are rendered by the game at runtime, never baked into PNGs (except meme template frames).
characters_atlas is OPAQUE (flat per-portrait backgrounds); the meme compositor crops cells and uses them as-is inside panels.
All frame coordinates are top-left origin, in source-atlas pixels.
